plain_english: The grace-drop stationed in the Lord, and devotion come as if to meet me — when will the pair, joined, take root in such a body?
sanskrit_cite: yaḥ prasādalava īśvarasthito yā ca bhaktir iva mām upeyuṣī tau parasparasamanvitau kadā tādṛśe vapuṣi rūḍhim eṣyataḥ

plain_english: Born of chewing His lordship, may some inner joy-juice rise; here always be supreme for me — knowledge-yoga's glories far off.
sanskrit_cite: tvatprabhutvaparicarvaṇajanmā ko 'py udetu paritoṣaraso 'ntaḥ sarvakālam iha me param astu jñānayogamahimādi vidūre

plain_english: Like the worldly, let my thirst for objects swell — only seeing them as Your body, unconstructed.
sanskrit_cite: lokavadbhavatu me viṣayeṣu sphīta eva bhagavanparitarṣaḥ kevalaṃ tava śarīratayaitān+ lokayeyam aham astavikalpaḥ

plain_english: In body-grounds and in mind, Lord, and in breath's course where difference has come — and in those consciousness-paths — by Yourself be plain to me, Thyself.
sanskrit_cite: dehabhūmiṣu tathā manasi tvaṃ prāṇavartmani ca bhedam upete saṃvidaḥ pathiṣu teṣu ca tena svātmanā mama bhava sphuṭarūpaḥ

plain_english: May these thrilled faculties fall into their own seats — never, Lord, even slightly, the daring of non-difference-rupture.
sanskrit_cite: nijanijeṣu padeṣu patantv imāḥ karaṇavṛttaya ullasitā mama kṣaṇamapīśa manāg api maiva bhūt tvadavibhedarasakṣatisāhasam

plain_english: Light, soft, white-pure, cool — contemplating by possession-force a body — may I exceed those dealings of the all-thing-road.
sanskrit_cite: laghumasṛṇasitācchaśītalaṃ bhavadāveśavaśena bhāvayan vapur akhilapadārthapaddhater vyavahārān ativartayeya tān

plain_english: May my self-body bloom as You; may worlds join my limbs; may all this duality-sport, even recalled, become untellable.
sanskrit_cite: vikasatu svavapur bhavadātmakaṃ samupayāntu jaganti mamāṅgatām vrajatu sarvam idaṃ dvayavalgitaṃ smṛtipathopagame 'py anupākhyatām

plain_english: May there rise, looking at such Yours, a flood of supreme nectar — so my filling of non-duality's dread gorge happens.
sanskrit_cite: samudiyād api tādṛśatāvakānana viloka parāmṛtasamplavaḥ mama ghaṭeta yathā bhavadadvayāprathanaghoradarīparipūraṇam

plain_english: If ever by the thinnest union-drops — may I turn from all world-pleasures; or shall I, fallen from both, be...?
sanskrit_cite: api kadācana tāvakasaṅgamāmṛtakaṇācchuraṇena tanīyasā sakalalokasukheṣu parāṅmukho na bhavitāsmy ubhayacyuta eva kim

plain_english: Ever at Your lotus-feet, of me the best hamsa moving in the lake — above from root below, and from inside, may devotion's lotus-stalk bend up, unborn Lord.
sanskrit_cite: satatam eva bhavaccaraṇāmbujākaracarasya hi haṃsavarasya me upari mūlatalād api cāntarād upanamatv aja bhaktimṛṇālikā

plain_english: May all things come under thought's scope and vision's footing for me; may vision-thought-light-nectar-essences blaze supreme.
sanskrit_cite: upayāntu vibho samastavastūny api cintāviṣayaṃ dṛśaḥ padaṃ ca mama darśanacintanaprakāśāmṛtasārāṇi paraṃ parisphurantu

plain_english: Lord, in crashing hardships, as names bend down, may I be — fear gone only while limb-joined, exceeding-joy-mad.
sanskrit_cite: parameśvara teṣu teṣu kṛcchreṣv api nāmopanamatsv ahaṃ bhaveyam na paraṃ gatabhīs tvadaṅgasaṅgādupajātādhikasammado 'pi yāvat

plain_english: The universe woven in Your self is shown outside by You alone — what stands firm-certain: may it now shine plain.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadātmani viśvam umbhitaṃ yad bhavataivāpi bahiḥ prakāśyate tat iti yad dṛḍhaniścayopajuṣṭaṃ tad idāniṃ sphuṭam eva bhāsatām
